audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer carried a blanket 'Skill 5-6/10' on all seven rows while the content layer and the packet both read Syndra / Skill / Skill / Skill / Zed / Zed / Syndra.
audit.why: Dark Sphere is 800 range with a 7s cooldown and shoves for free, so level 1 is hers. Death Mark at 6 kills an immobile champion with no dash. Late, stacked Transcendent splinters turn Unleashed Power into a 675-range execute.
audit.corrected: Full sides moved to match the content layer exactly; rows 1-3 already read Skill on both layers so no edit was needed there. phases[0].why and phases[6].why rewritten in the same group because both described Zed winning stages that belong to Syndra.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ratings were flat across a chart that swings twice.
audit.why: Zed's spike is 6 into an immobile target and first-item lethality; Syndra's are level 1 range and the late stacked-sphere ult.
audit.corrected: 4/10 on the two Syndra rows, 7/10 on the two Zed rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two interactions that actually decide this lane were absent from every field a player reads mid-game: Transcendent's splinters give Force of Will bonus TRUE damage (so armour and MR are the wrong purchase), and upgraded Unleashed Power EXECUTES low targets. The page also never named Scatter the Weak's flat 15-second cooldown, which is the longest punish window in the matchup.
audit.why: Riot's passive text lists the splinter upgrades directly: Force of Will bonus true damage, Scatter the Weak increased width and slows all targets, Unleashed Power executes low health targets. E is 15s at every rank.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns, tradeBad, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d, enemyWin and report[9].t.

audit.why: It is the field that holds the numbers.
audit.corrected: Scatter the Weak flat 15s, Dark Sphere 7s, Force of Will 12s to 8s, Unleashed Power 120/100/80.

audit.why: champ-gender.js lists syndra as female; the lint enumerated every field.
audit.corrected: Every flagged field in scope rewritten with correct pronouns and, where it was a bleed, with a body that answers its own title. report[4].t and report[11].t were left for the report-rewrite cap.
